title: Amulet of Selûne's Chosen
summary: Once per Long Rest, touch an ally to restore 1d8 HP. The ally can fall asleep if it fails a DC 10 Constitution save.

fields.Effect: Selûne’s Dream is an Action once per Long Rest. Touch an ally to restore 1d8 HP. The target makes a DC 10 Constitution save or gains Sleeping for 2 turns.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Limits: No effect on Undead or Constructs.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
